recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If this ICD formatting guidance needs future maintenance, update the THO/UTG source for the 'Using ICD with HL7 Standards' page rather than reintroducing detailed ICD usage prose into FHIR core.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 Vocabulary issue asked for ICD formatting guidance and resolved that the ICD-10 page should explicitly require the period form, such as 123.4, for conformance.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 36036280db3b94ad603d4d97ca2a019286de349c, matching Jira's svn revision 14644 comment, added the exact sentence 'ICD codes SHALL be represented with the period included, e.g. 123.4' to source/icd.html.
additional_context: FHIR-35933 later removed the detailed external-code-system usage pages, including source/icd.html, from FHIR core and moved authoritative 'Using X with HL7 Standards' guidance to THO. Current core keeps source/terminologies-systems.html and the ICD SID pages in build scope, marks Defined Externally content as non-authoritative, and links the ICD row to THO. The current THO ICD page still includes the exact period-required rule.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit is needed because adding the rule to source/sid-icd-10.html would duplicate migrated THO guidance on a page that now only identifies the SID URI and source, while the build-scoped Code Systems page already points to authoritative THO ICD guidance.
